description: Commission of Elections - Appointed Mr. A. R. Thavappiragasam as a Member of Valikamam South Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Valikamam South Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes, including the declaration of an elected member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations of elected members.
